subject.why: Clearly depicts the requested ship's bow with the smiling dolphin figurehead and sails.

category.why: Object rests naturally on a wide water foreground with a clean sky backdrop.

clean.why: Free of text, interfaces, frames, and background characters.

framing.why: The top of the sail is cut off by the upper edge rather than retaining clear margin.

colour.why: Bright, saturated palette with clear separation between the red hull, gold, and blue sea.

detail.why: Volumes are simplified and chunky with no noisy micro-details or clutter.

style.why: Smooth, rounded forms with soft shading matching the casual game references.

fix: Scale down the ship slightly to leave clear margin space above the sail.
